'''Brian Wehler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Roseville Enduro]] on 10 March 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS Basic]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS Basic Modded]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1933">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-21-hell-in-a-cell-enduro-01d1933/ hell-in-a-cell-enduro-01], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 21 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-21-hell-in-a-cell-enduro-01d1933/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
